tool_input.command: tail -n +2 data/batch_1.csv | cut -d',' -f1 | sort > /tmp/batch1_ids.txt && tail -n +2 data/batch_2.csv | cut -d',' -f1 | sort > /tmp/batch2_ids.txt && tail -n +2 data/batch_3.csv | cut -d',' -f1 | sort > /tmp/batch3_ids.txt && echo "Batch 1 unique: $(wc -l < /tmp/batch1_ids.txt)" && echo "Batch 2 unique: $(wc -l < /tmp/batch2_ids.txt)" && echo "Batch 3 unique: $(wc -l < /tmp/batch3_ids.txt)" && echo "Overlap 1&2: $(comm -12 /tmp/batch1_ids.txt /tmp/batch2_ids.txt | wc -l)" && echo "Overlap 1&3: $(comm -12 /tmp/batch1_ids.txt /tmp/batch3_ids.txt | wc -l)" && echo "Overlap 2&3: $(comm -12 /tmp/batch2_ids.txt /tmp/batch3_ids.txt | wc -l)"

cat data/batch_1.csv data/batch_2.csv data/batch_3.csv | tail -n +2 | sort -t',' -k1,1 -k4,4 -r | awk -F',' '!seen[$1]++' | sort -t',' -k4,4 -n >> /tmp/deduped.csv && echo "row_id,status,balance,updated_at" > /tmp/deduped_final.csv && cat /tmp/deduped.csv >> /tmp/deduped_final.csv && wc -l /tmp/deduped_final.csv
cat data/batch_1.csv data/batch_2.csv data/batch_3.csv | tail -n +2 | cut -d',' -f1 | sort -u | wc -l

# Combine all batches, skip headers, sort by row_id and updated_at descending, keep first occurrence of each row_id
tail -n +2 data/batch_1.csv > /tmp/all.csv
tail -n +2 data/batch_2.csv >> /tmp/all.csv
tail -n +2 data/batch_3.csv >> /tmp/all.csv

# Sort by row_id ascending, then updated_at descending, then keep first of each row_id
sort -t',' -k1,1 -k4,4 -rn /tmp/all.csv | awk -F',' '!seen[$1]++' > /tmp/deduped_body.csv

# Add header
echo "row_id,status,balance,updated_at" > /tmp/deduped_final.csv
cat /tmp/deduped_body.csv >> /tmp/deduped_final.csv

wc -l /tmp/deduped_final.csv
head -5 /tmp/deduped_final.csv
tail -5 /tmp/deduped_final.csv
cat data/batch_1.csv data/batch_2.csv data/batch_3.csv | tail -n +2 | cut -d',' -f1 | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -10

# Check for the issue
grep "row_id" /tmp/all.csv | head -5

# Let me check the actual count more carefully
tail -n +2 data/batch_1.csv | wc -l
tail -n +2 data/batch_2.csv | wc -l
tail -n +2 data/batch_3.csv | wc -l
cat <(tail -n +2 data/batch_1.csv) <(tail -n +2 data/batch_2.csv) <(tail -n +2 data/batch_3.csv) | cut -d',' -f1 | sort -u | wc -l

# Check R00019 - should have updated_at 1770491880000 from batch_1
grep "R00019" /tmp/deduped_final.csv

hops fg create accounts75b440 --version 1 --primary-key row_id --event-time updated_at --features "row_id:string,status:string,balance:double,updated_at:bigint" --online --description "Accounts feature table with latest revisions"
hops sql "SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM accounts75b440_1" --json 2>/dev/null
hops fg info accounts75b440 --version 1 --json 2>/dev/null | grep -A2 -B2 online

# Check R00019 - should appear only once with the latest timestamp
hops fg preview accounts75b440 --version 1 --json 2>/dev/null | grep -A3 '"row_id": "R00019"'
